minutes.headline: School building project closed out under budget; committee signed MSBA closeout documents and approved the 2018-19 calendar.
minutes.summary: The committee heard the superintendent's report on attendance and community events, then took up the final closeout of the school building project with the building committee chair, covering the budget revision request and commissioning certificate. It approved the 2018-2019 calendar, discussed state snow-day options for a later presentation, and heard that the superintendent will trim two lines to hold the budget to the stated percentage.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to let the chair sign the MSBA budget revision request, which moved money within the construction budget into the general contingency fund.
The committee voted to let the chair sign the commissioning certificate of completion, part of the final closeout of the school building project.
The school building project finished under budget because bids came in lower, and the local share is expected to be under the budgeted amount, pending the MSBA audit.
The committee approved the 2018-2019 school calendar.
The superintendent will adjust the curriculum adoption and capital projects lines to hold the budget to the stated percentage.

why_it_matters: A building project that finishes under budget can lower the local share paid by the town budget, mostly taxes, but the final amount depends on the state audit.
The calendar sets the 2018-2019 school year for families, and trimming curriculum and capital lines to meet the budget percentage affects what the schools can buy and repair next year.
